headlines.snippet: Tehran, IRNA — The Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) Navy Public Relations announced that two violating oil tankers exploded on the unauthorized route of the Strait of Hormuz.

headlines.title: Fourth violating oil tanker explodes after hitting mine east of Strait of Hormuz
headlines.snippet: Tehran, IRNA – A fourth oil tanker violating designated maritime routes in the Strait of Hormuz exploded and caught fire after striking a naval mine early on Tuesday, the IRGC Navy announced.

headlines.title: Iran tightens security measures in Strait of Hormuz: Army
headlines.snippet: Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s Army spokesperson Brigadier General Mohammad Akraminia says the military had stepped up surveillance and control of the Strait of Hormuz, warning that vessels must coordinate their passage with the Iranian Armed Forces to ensure safe transit.

headlines.title: Iran: Zionist regime poses gravest threat to Lebanon’s independence, stability
headlines.snippet: Tehran, IRNA – Iran's Foreign Ministry has strongly condemned the Israeli aggression against Lebanon, stating that the attacks—coinciding with the country's Independence Day— show the Zionist regime poses the greatest threat to its independence, territorial integrity, and stability.

headlines.snippet: TEHRAN, Nov. 25 (MNA) – Iran's Army air defense forces destroyed two U.S. drones, a Lucas and an MQ-9, over the western and eastern Strait of Hormuz.

headlines.title: Iran UN envoy warns on military use of AI
headlines.snippet: TEHRAN, Nov. 25 (MNA) – Iran's ambassador to the UN warned that the weaponization of artificial intelligence and its use in aggression raise serious concerns, citing reports that the U.S. used advanced AI systems in the 2026 war on Iran.

headlines.title: How did Iran change the power equation in region?
headlines.snippet: TEHRAN, Nov. 25 (MNA) – Iran has upended a core US assumption: that its military bases in West Asia guarantee security. By raising the cost of America’s presence, Tehran has forced Washington to rethink its regional strategy.

headlines.title: Violating oil tanker catches fire east of Strait of Hormuz

headlines.title: 1 Flogging of Iranian singer Parastoo Ahmadi sparks outrage on social media
headlines.snippet: The flogging of Iranian singer Parastoo Ahmadi and four members of her concert team on Monday sparked outrage on social media, with artists, activists and other users condemning the punishment and denouncing restrictions on women’s artistic expression in Iran.

headlines.title: 2 Iran develops new ballistic missile variants, US think tanks say
headlines.snippet: Iran appears to be developing new ballistic missile variants designed to improve its ability to strike targets and evade air defenses, even as its capacity for mass production remains unclear, two US think tanks said on Tuesday.

headlines.title: 3 Iran’s rial falls past 2.85 million to the dollar
headlines.snippet: The US dollar broke through 2.85 million rials on Iran’s open market on Tuesday, deepening a currency crisis driven by soaring inflation, a US naval blockade that has choked oil exports and mounting US financial pressure.

headlines.title: 4 ANALYSIS Tehran claims its missiles can reach Europe. What has it shown?

headlines.title: 5 Iranian media walk back tanker convoy claims after days of blockade-breaking hype
